newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong to host global funds meeting in October.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong to host global funds meeting in October.

text.p: Hong Kong will host the International Investment Funds Conference in October, which will be attended by funds representing US$5.6 trillion, the Hong Kong Investment Funds Association (HKIFA) said on Thursday.
The objectives of the conference are to share information on the commercial and regulatory aspects of the industry's global development and to discuss global standards and guidelines, the HKIFA said.
The conference will also provide an opportunity for international fund managers to investigate the implications of China's resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1, the HKIFA said.
The association said Hong Kong's fund industry represents assets of US$100 billion excluding those managed by private banks, insurance companies and non-member funds.
